name: Subactor Secret Intake
summary: Exact URI adapters that reuse scoped deployment credentials or mint and observe one-time Vault intake via Control.
description: Calls only deployment-controlled Subactor Control endpoints. Deployment requests carry validated domain, webspace and destination Vault identifiers so Control may reuse one unambiguous Vault or domain-bound environment source. The connector never accepts password or API key values; consume is a readiness poll.
